solves problems by prioritizing customer needs over a system's needs, involving the human
perspective in every step of the problem-solving process — observing the problem in context,
brainstorming, conceptualizing, developing, and implementing the solution [1][3]. Its lineage runs
from ergonomics research at Bell Labs through Donald Norman's The Design of Everyday Things
